faq.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subheading: Answers to the most common questions about private transfer from Oradea

items.question: How much does the transfer from Oradea to Budapest Airport cost?
items.answer: Private transfer from Oradea to Budapest Liszt Ferenc Airport costs 180 EUR for 1-4 passengers. The price is fixed and includes all fees, regardless of traffic or delays.

items.question: How many people fit in the car and how much luggage can I bring?
items.answer: The Škoda Octavia 2019 estate comfortably fits up to 4 passengers. The spacious trunk has enough room for 4 large suitcases and carry-on bags.

items.question: What languages does the driver speak?
items.answer: The driver is a professional with 25 years of experience and speaks English, Dutch, Romanian and Hungarian fluently. Communication is clear with no language barriers.

items.question: Can I pay by card or only cash?
items.answer: We accept cash payment in EUR or RON. For other payment methods, please contact us on WhatsApp before the trip.

items.question: How long does the trip from Oradea to Budapest take?
items.answer: The journey from Oradea to Budapest Airport takes approximately 2.5-3 hours, depending on traffic and border crossing wait times. We monitor road conditions in real time.

items.question: Do you offer transfers to Debrecen Airport?
items.answer: Yes, we offer private transfer from Oradea to Debrecen Airport at a fixed price of 60 EUR for 1-4 passengers. The journey takes approximately 1 hour.
